**Article Details for PMID: 42842139**

**Title:** Durable treatment response to Trastuzumab deruxtecan in two patients with recurrent grade III anaplastic ependymoma.

**Authors:** Dietmar Krex, Irina A Kerle, Arne Grey, Stephanie Pleißner, Stephan Richter, Christoph Heining, Stefan Fröhling, Hanno Glimm, Martin Bornhäuser, Gunnar Folprecht, Andy Göbel, Cornelia S Link-Rachner

**Journal:** Molecular and cellular pediatrics
**Publication Date:** 2026-10-07
**DOI:** 10.1186/s40348-026-00263-y
**PMC ID:** 13646213
**Full Text Available:** Yes
**Full Text URL:** https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13646213/


**Abstract:**
Anaplastic ependymoma is a rare and aggressive central nervous system malignancy for which effective systemic treatment options are limited. Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd), an antibody-drug conjugate targeting human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2), has demonstrated intracranial activity in patients with HER2-positive solid tumors. We report two patients with recurrent, heavily pretreated anaplastic ependymoma and molecular evidence of HER2 activation who received T-DXd as off-label therapy.
